cases.prompt: Read options.md and rank the three approaches for this team. Use the stated constraints and explain the main tradeoff. Do not build anything.

files.workflow.md: Our app asks a text-generating LLM to output JSON with a feedback category and whether follow-up is needed, then repairs malformed JSON.
